hollis models (version dev)
  auto       fallback strategy: cloud first, on-device on failure
  cloud      AFM 3 Cloud (Private Cloud Compute)
  on-device  AFM 3 Core or AFM 3 Core Advanced (by hardware)
  chatgpt    OpenAI ChatGPT extension for Apple Intelligence
  local      Native Foundation Models SDK: unavailable: native helper availability has not been checked (inference not tested)

Apple publishes no backend model IDs. The internal Shortcuts parameter
strings are included in --json; background in README "Model tiers".
